description: Puts the dashboard's version before the current one back, as its next version. The workspace owner decides whether assistants' dashboard changes wait as a DRAFT for a person to accept in Data Studio (the default) or apply at once; the answer's draft field says which happened, so say it waits for them only when draft is true. Nothing earlier is lost; every version is kept.

as_draft.description: true: save it as a draft for a person to accept even where your changes may apply at once (to propose rather than change).

dashboard_id.description: The dashboard's id (list_dashboards gives them, dsh_...).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: undo_dashboard
title: Undo a dashboard's last change
